中心概况

让区域研究形成可持续的合作网络

Initiated by the Asia-Pacific Applied Economics Association (APAEA) and partner institutions in Xi'an, the Center combines complementary strengths in research, international engagement, industry collaboration and capacity building to address major economic, financial, environmental and technological challenges across the Asia-Pacific region and beyond.

The Center serves as an international collaborative platform connecting universities, policymakers, central banks, government agencies, international organizations, industry partners and doctoral researchers. Its work is designed to inform policy, support innovation, strengthen research training and contribute to sustainable economic and social development.

Established7 July 2026
Initiating organizationAsia-Pacific Applied Economics Association (APAEA)
Partner networkNine schools and research units in Xi'an
OfficeRoom 213, School of Economics and Management, Xi'an University of Technology

愿景

建设具有全球影响力的区域社会经济系统研究中心，培养未来研究领军人才，为亚太地区的政策、产业与社会发展提供高质量证据。
国际协作 政策影响 人才培养

Strategic objectives

Turning research collaboration into lasting impact

The Center's framework defines five objectives spanning international research, evidence-based policymaking, researcher development, industry translation and network building.

  1. 01

    International research excellence

    Produce internationally recognized research for publication in leading SSCI-indexed journals.

  2. 02

    Evidence-based policy collaboration

    Connect researchers with policymakers, industry and international organizations to improve evidence-based decision-making.

  3. 03

    Future research leaders

    Develop future researchers through structured PhD mentoring, research training and international mobility.

  4. 04

    Industry translation

    Translate research into products, services, policy tools and decision-support applications with industry partners.

  5. 05

    A sustainable international network

    Build a durable network linking universities, governments, central banks, development agencies and the private sector.

Expected outcomes

The Center will support high-impact publications, international research collaboration, competitive funding, doctoral development, policy engagement and industry translation, creating long-term value for researchers, students, governments, businesses and communities across the Asia-Pacific region.

研究领域

从区域问题出发，形成跨学科研究议程

研究方向依据中心方案归纳为四组，便于联合研究项目、会议活动和研究成果长期归档。

C·E

气候、能源与可持续发展

关注气候金融、绿色转型、能源经济及可持续发展政策。

F·AI

金融稳定、数字金融与人工智能

研究技术变化对金融体系、企业决策和经济治理的影响。

R·P

区域发展与公共政策

围绕区域经济差异、制度环境和循证政策开展联合研究。

S·W

社会发展、教育与福祉

关注教育发展、心理健康、工作福祉和包容性学术环境。

项目与活动

六类合作，连接研究全周期

从形成问题、组织研究，到传播成果和服务社会，每类活动都有明确的合作对象与产出。

  1. 01

    国际会议与政策论坛

    汇集学者、政策部门、中央银行、国际组织和产业代表。

  2. 02

    SSCI 期刊专刊

    围绕具有战略意义的议题组织高质量研究成果。

  3. 03

    联合研究计划

    联合申报项目、开展实证研究并推动国际发表。

  4. 04

    博士生培养

    提供联合指导、研究训练、论文发展和国际交流机会。

  5. 05

    产业合作与成果转化

    发展咨询、政策工具、决策支持系统和应用研究。

  6. 06

    社会发展与福祉

    推动心理健康、韧性培养、同伴支持和跨文化交流。

Related activities

Academic exchange across universities and generations

Center members and partner institutions convene international conferences, doctoral forums and academic lectures on climate change, the digital economy, green transition and data science.

7 July 2026Xi'an, China

Doctoral Forum on Climate Change and the Digital Economy

Co-hosted by the School of Economics and Management at Xi'an University of Technology and APAEA, the forum brought together scholars and doctoral researchers from Monash University and universities across Xi'an. A keynote and two parallel sessions examined climate-change economics, carbon pricing, ESG, regional socio-economic systems and digital industry clusters, with 14 papers presented.

Original story and imageXi'an University of Technology↗
29–31 May 2026Xi'an, China

Second International Conference on Sustainable Development and Digital Transformation & Green Engineering and Sustainable Development Forum (SDDT & GESD 2026)

Co-hosted by APAEA and Chang'an University, organized by its School of Economics and Management, and co-organized by Xi'an University of Technology, the conference featured keynote addresses and nearly 30 oral presentations. Discussions covered sustainable construction, complex systems and intelligent management, as well as the digital economy and green transition, strengthening exchange across engineering, management and economics.

Original stories and imagesXi'an University of Technology report↗Chang'an University conference notice↗
28 May 2026Xi'an, China

Seminar on Emerging Issues in Chinese Economic Development

Co-organized by the schools of economics and management at Northwest University and Xi'an University of Technology, APAEA, and Emerging Markets Finance and Trade, the seminar combined keynote lectures with research presentations on local-government debt risk, population aging, green finance, resilience in the new-energy sector and outward foreign direct investment.

Source: Center conference archive
14 July 2025Xi'an, China

Hou Wailu Academic Lecture No. 440 and Workshop on Climate Change Governance and Climate Cost Assessment

Northwest University's Yulin School of Carbon Neutrality convened the workshop with university offices, its School of Economics and Management, APAEA and Xi'an University of Technology. Paresh Kumar Narayan, Lu Xu and Jinfeng Ma addressed climate-change economics, climate vulnerability and financial risk, and CCUS development in Shaanxi. Seven selected papers examined ecological governance, carbon markets and corporate green transition.

Original story and imagesNorthwest University↗
22 March 2026Lanzhou, China

Professor Paresh Kumar Narayan Visits Lanzhou University of Finance and Economics for an Academic Lecture

Professor Narayan presented “Can Digital Payments Sustainably Stimulate Household Consumption Growth? A Time-Inconsistent Preferences Perspective.” Drawing on psychology and behavioral economics, he examined the mechanisms through which digital payments influence consumption and whether those effects persist over time, followed by discussion on research design, data and model extensions.

Original story and imageLanzhou University of Finance and Economics↗
6 December 2025Beijing, China

2025 Data Science Young Scholars Forum and APAEA Doctoral Scholars Conference

Hosted by the School of Statistics and Data Science at Capital University of Economics and Business, the conference brought together young scholars and doctoral researchers from 25 universities. Its 21 hybrid parallel sessions covered artificial intelligence, green finance, climate finance, risk management, digital finance and corporate finance. More than 30 students took leading roles in organizing, chairing and presenting at the event.

Original story and imagesCapital University of Economics and Business↗

Center established7 JUL 2026

Joint Research Center for Regional Socio-Economic Systems established in Xi'an

APAEA, the School of Economics and Management at Xi'an University of Technology, and partner institutions in Xi'an jointly established the Center during the Doctoral Forum on Climate Change and the Digital Economy. Paresh Kumar Narayan serves as Chair of the Board and Yaobo Shi as Director.
